scope: Stage 24 junior-middle subject laboratory specification and planned work packages

results.result: Goals, scope, two-pass visual direction, safety invariants, work packages, verification methods and acceptance criteria were fixed before Stage 24 implementation.

Junior-middle now uses a distinct quiet subject laboratory with subject rail, current evidence nodes, one active action, help and a neutral 25-minute break cue. It does not add child navigation or fabricate ordering. Persistent accessible ordering remains WP24-4, so WP24-2 is not yet complete.

remaining: WP24-2 release variant and persistent ordering, then WP24-3 through WP24-7 implementation and verification
